Messages.Author: David Paven
Messages.Body:
L. Scott Johnson (lsc...@crl.com) wrote:
: In article <DA7os...@news.hawaii.edu>,
: Steven K Bauer <sba...@uhunix.uhcc.Hawaii.Edu> wrote:
: >The Question should have read:

: >
: > Can you use Superior effect of spying mission if your bleed for
: >zero (gangrel de-evelotion) or the bleed is reduced to zero (Telepathic
: >Counter).

: No. and No.

No. and Yes. !

If you bleed for zero because of a Gangrel De-evolution, YOU
CAN'T use superior effect of Spying Mission, but if the bleed is
reduced to zero by a Telephatic Counter YOU CAN :

> Date: Mon, 26 Sep 94 20:19:45 -0700
> Subject: [O] Rules Group answers to Jyhad questions

> *** Rules Group answers to Jyhad questions, 9/23/94 ***

> 29) Anyway, if I want to use Telepathic Counter against my opponent's
> blee, but he wants to use Spying Mission, who wins?

> Spying Mission would win, because the acting minion plays cards first,
> and the bleed would have already been reduced by the time the
> Telepathic Counter would be played.

VyGER

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <DA7os...@news.hawaii.edu>,
Steven K Bauer <sba...@uhunix.uhcc.Hawaii.Edu> wrote:
>The Question should have read:
>
> Can you use Superior effect of spying mission if your bleed for
>zero (gangrel de-evelotion) or the bleed is reduced to zero (Telepathic
>Counter).

No. and No.

Superior Spying mission has an effect which includes "instead of removing pool"
Therefore, you can't use the remainder of this effect (place on the
acting vampire for +2 bleed later) since you can't meet the requirements
(the cost - the sacrificing of the removal of pool).

Yes, but this has been overturned:

Subject: Revised Jyhad FAQ: 4/18/95 version
Date: 18 Apr 1995 23:01:44 GMT

Q: If I want to use Telepathic Counter against my
opponent's bleed and he wants to use Spying Mission, who
wins?
A: Telepathic Counter would win, because the card reduces the
bleed to 0, therefore Spying Mission would have no effect.

---
Now, Spying Mission is an effect which modifiesa successful bleed
(and so would be played after all bleed modifiers took effect).
